changes: First library release, for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74 on the Modwerk base: a wavefolder on the send bus.
Send each track from its SEND page (AMP twice); choose WAVEFOLDER on SEND FX (DELAY twice on the FX track, FUNC + A).
Eight controls, FOLD to BLND, lockable on the FX track; DYN makes loud hits fold more than ghost notes.
Not yet tested on a unit: this exact build.
